<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Tidal Binary</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        body {
            background: #000;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        canvas {
            display: block;
            width: 1600px;   /* CSS display size — can differ from drawing resolution */                        
            height: 1200px;   
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <canvas id="c"></canvas>
    <script>
        "use strict";

        const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        let W, H, R1, R2, cx, cy, sep, s1x, s1y, s2x, s2y;

        // ── Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        const R1_FRAC = 0.25;   // star 1 radius as fraction of min(W,H)
        const R2_FRAC = 0.2;   // star 2 radius as fraction of min(W,H)
        const SEP_FRAC = 0.75;   // center-to-center separation as fraction of min(W,H)
        const TIDAL_SCALE = 2;    // binary tidal amplitude: eps = TIDAL_SCALE * (R/sep)^3

        function resize() {
            W = 3200;
            H = 2400;
            R1 = Math.min(W, H) * R1_FRAC;
            R2 = Math.min(W, H) * R2_FRAC;
            sep = Math.min(W, H) * SEP_FRAC;
            cx = W / 2;
            cy = H / 2;
            s1x = cx - W / 2 + R1*1.1; 
            s1y = cy + H / 2 - R1*1.1;
            s2x = cx + W / 2 - R2*1.1; 
            s2y = cy - H / 2 + R2*1.1;
            canvas.width = W;
            canvas.height = H;
        }
        resize();
        window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

        // ── Mouse tracking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        let mouseX = W * 2, mouseY = cy;
        let prevX = mouseX, prevY = mouseY;

        window.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
            mouseX = e.clientX;
            mouseY = e.clientY;
        });

        // ── Per-star cursor tidal state ───────────────────────────────────
        const stars = [
            { tidalAngle: 0, epsilon: 0 },  // star 1 (left,  red)
            { tidalAngle: 0, epsilon: 0 },  // star 2 (right, gold)
        ];

        const FILL = ["#E8C018", "#C8302A"];

        let lastT = null;

        // Draw one star as the sum of two independent P2 tidal deformations
        function drawStar(scx, scy, R, eps1, ang1, eps2, ang2, fill) {
            const N = 360;
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                const theta = (i / N) * 2 * Math.PI;
                const P2_1 = (3 * Math.cos(theta - ang1) ** 2 - 1) / 2;
                const P2_2 = (3 * Math.cos(theta - ang2) ** 2 - 1) / 2;
                const r = R * (1 + eps1 * P2_1 + eps2 * P2_2);
                i === 0
                    ? ctx.moveTo(scx + r * Math.cos(theta), scy + r * Math.sin(theta))
                    : ctx.lineTo(scx + r * Math.cos(theta), scy + r * Math.sin(theta));
            }
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fillStyle = fill;
            ctx.fill();
        }

        function animate(t) {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            if (lastT === null) { lastT = t; return; }
            const dt = Math.min((t - lastT) / 1000, 0.05);
            lastT = t;

            const vel = Math.hypot(mouseX - prevX, mouseY - prevY) / dt;
            prevX = mouseX; prevY = mouseY;

            // Update cursor tidal state for each star independently
            const centers = [[s1x, s1y, R1], [s2x, s2y, R2]];
            for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
                const [scx, scy, Ri] = centers[i];
                const dxm = mouseX - scx, dym = mouseY - scy;
                const d_norm = Math.max(0.3, Math.hypot(dxm, dym) / Ri);
                const angle = Math.atan2(dym, dxm);

                const target = Math.min(0.06, 0.10 / d_norm ** 3)
                    + Math.min(0.02, vel * 0.000015);

                const dA = ((angle - stars[i].tidalAngle + 3 * Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI)) - Math.PI;
                stars[i].tidalAngle += dA * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / 0.15));
                stars[i].epsilon += (target - stars[i].epsilon) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / 0.2));
            }

            // Companion tidal parameters — each star uses its own radius
            const epsBin1 = Math.min(0.15, TIDAL_SCALE * (R1 / sep) ** 3);
            const epsBin2 = Math.min(0.15, TIDAL_SCALE * (R2 / sep) ** 3);
            const ang1to2 = Math.atan2(s2y - s1y, s2x - s1x);  // star 1 bulges toward star 2
            const ang2to1 = ang1to2 + Math.PI;                  // star 2 bulges toward star 1

            // ── Draw ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

            drawStar(s1x, s1y, R1, epsBin1, ang1to2, stars[0].epsilon, stars[0].tidalAngle, FILL[0]);
            drawStar(s2x, s2y, R2, epsBin2, ang2to1, stars[1].epsilon, stars[1].tidalAngle, FILL[1]);

            // Unperturbed outlines
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
            ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
            for (const [scx, scy, Ri] of centers) {
                ctx.setLineDash([Ri * 0.07, Ri * 0.05]);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(scx, scy, Ri, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    </script>
</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Stellar Internal Structure</title>
<style>
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body {
    background: #000000;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
}
canvas { display: block; cursor: pointer; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

const W = 900, H = 400;
const dpr = Math.max(3, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
canvas.width = W * dpr;
canvas.height = H * dpr;
canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

// ── Star definitions ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const stars = [
    {
        name: 'High-mass star', mass: 'M > 1.5 M⊙',
        cx: 155, cy: 178, R: 120,
        zones: [
            { type: 'convective', rf: [0, 0.25], nCells: 4 },
            { type: 'radiative',  rf: [0.25, 1.0] }
        ]
    },
    {
        name: 'Sun-like star', mass: '0.5 < M < 1.5 M⊙',
        cx: 450, cy: 178, R: 98,
        zones: [
            { type: 'radiative',  rf: [0, 0.65] },
            { type: 'convective', rf: [0.65, 1.0], nCells: 6 }
        ]
    },
    {
        name: 'Low-mass star', mass: 'M < 0.5 M⊙',
        cx: 740, cy: 178, R: 68,
        zones: [
            { type: 'convective', rf: [0, 1.0], nCells: 6 }
        ]
    }
];

// ── Particle classes ─────────────────────────────────────────────
const allParticles = [];

class RadParticle {
    constructor(s, z) {
        this.s = s;
        this.z = z;
        this.rMin = Math.max(z.rf[0] * s.R, 6);
        this.rMax = z.rf[1] * s.R - 2;
        this.reset();
    }

    reset() {
        this.r  = this.rMin + Math.random() * (this.rMax - this.rMin);
        this.th = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.spd = 0.18 + Math.random() * 0.28;
        this.dth = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005;
        this.sz  = 5 + Math.random() * 3;
    }

    update() {
        this.r  += this.spd;
        this.th += this.dth;
        if (Math.random() < 0.03) this.dth = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.006;
        if (this.r > this.rMax) {
            this.r  = this.rMin;
            this.th = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        }
    }

    xy() {
        return [this.s.cx + this.r * Math.cos(this.th),
                this.s.cy - this.r * Math.sin(this.th)];
    }

    angle() { return -this.th; }

    alpha() {
        const t = (this.r - this.rMin) / (this.rMax - this.rMin);
        return 0.25 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.55;
    }
}

class ConvParticle {
    constructor(s, z, ci) {
        this.s = s;
        this.z = z;
        this.rMin = Math.max(z.rf[0] * s.R, 7);
        this.rMax = z.rf[1] * s.R - 2;
        const n = z.nCells;
        this.thC = 2 * Math.PI * ci / n;
        this.thW = Math.PI / n * 0.72;
        this.rMid = (this.rMin + this.rMax) / 2;
        const dir = ci % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
        this.rH  = (this.rMax - this.rMin) / 2 * 0.82 * dir;
        this.ph  = 0;
        this.spd = 0.019 + Math.random() * 0.007;
        this.sz  = 5 + Math.random() * 2;
    }

    update() {
        this.ph += this.spd;
        if (this.ph > Math.PI * 2) this.ph -= Math.PI * 2;
    }

    _r()  { return this.rMid + this.rH * Math.sin(this.ph); }
    _th() { return this.thC + this.thW * Math.cos(this.ph); }

    xy() {
        const r = this._r(), th = this._th();
        return [this.s.cx + r * Math.cos(th),
                this.s.cy - r * Math.sin(th)];
    }

    angle() {
        const r  = this._r(), th = this._th();
        const dr  = this.rH  * Math.cos(this.ph);
        const dth = -this.thW * Math.sin(this.ph);
        const vx =  dr * Math.cos(th) - r * dth * Math.sin(th);
        const vy = -(dr * Math.sin(th) + r * dth * Math.cos(th));
        return Math.atan2(vy, vx);
    }

    alpha() { return 0.45 + 0.35 * Math.abs(Math.cos(this.ph)); }
}

// ── Create particles ─────────────────────────────────────────────
for (const s of stars) {
    for (const z of s.zones) {
        if (z.type === 'radiative') {
            const n = Math.max(18, Math.round(35 * (z.rf[1] - z.rf[0])));
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) allParticles.push(new RadParticle(s, z));
        } else {
            for (let c = 0; c < z.nCells; c++) {
                for (let p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
                    const cp = new ConvParticle(s, z, c);
                    cp.ph = Math.PI * 2 * p / 4 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25;
                    allParticles.push(cp);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ── Background starfield ─────────────────────────────────────────
const bgStars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    r: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.9,
    a: 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.35
}));

// ── Drawing helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function drawArrow(x, y, ang, sz, col, a) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(ang);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-sz, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(sz * 0.2, 0);
    ctx.strokeStyle = col;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sz, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(sz * 0.1, -sz * 0.38);
    ctx.lineTo(sz * 0.25, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(sz * 0.1,  sz * 0.38);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
}

function drawStarBody(star) {
    const { cx, cy, R, zones } = star;

    // Glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, R * 0.8, cx, cy, R * 1.45);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 170, 70, 0.10)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 170, 70, 0)');
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 1.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fill();

    // Zones (outermost first so inner zones paint over)
    const sorted = [...zones].sort((a, b) => b.rf[1] - a.rf[1]);
    for (const z of sorted) {
        const rIn  = z.rf[0] * R;
        const rOut = z.rf[1] * R;
        const lIn  = 89 - z.rf[0] * 47;
        const lOut = 89 - z.rf[1] * 47;

        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, Math.max(rIn, 1), cx, cy, rOut);
        if (z.type === 'radiative') {
            g.addColorStop(0, `hsl(48, 94%, ${lIn}%)`);
            g.addColorStop(1, `hsl(44, 88%, ${Math.max(lOut, 38)}%)`);
        } else {
            g.addColorStop(0, `hsl(30, 91%, ${lIn}%)`);
            g.addColorStop(1, `hsl(16, 84%, ${Math.max(lOut, 33)}%)`);
        }
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx, cy, rOut, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Zone boundaries (dashed)
    for (const z of zones) {
        if (z.rf[0] > 0.01) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(cx, cy, z.rf[0] * R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
        }
    }

    // Star outline
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,140,40,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
}

function drawLabels(star) {
    const { cx, cy, R, name, mass, zones } = star;

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';

    // Name
    ctx.fillStyle = '#eee';
    ctx.font = 'bold 17px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
    ctx.fillText(name, cx, cy - R - 26);

    // Mass range
    ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
    ctx.font = '14px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.fillText(mass, cx, cy - R - 8);

    // Zone labels below star
    ctx.font = '13px Georgia, serif';
    let ly = cy + R + 24;
    for (const z of zones) {
        let label;
        if (z.type === 'convective') {
            if (z.rf[0] < 0.01 && z.rf[1] > 0.99) label = 'Fully convective';
            else if (z.rf[0] < 0.01) label = 'Convective core';
            else label = 'Convective envelope';
        } else {
            if (z.rf[0] < 0.01) label = 'Radiative core';
            else label = 'Radiative envelope';
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = z.type === 'convective' ? '#FF8A65' : '#FFE082';
        ctx.fillText(label, cx, ly);
        ly += 20;
    }
}

function drawLegend() {
    const y = H - 28;
    ctx.font = '12px Georgia, serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

    // Radiative
    drawArrow(W / 2 - 235, y, 0, 8, '#FFD54F', 0.85);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
    ctx.fillText('Radiative transport (photon diffusion)', W / 2 - 220, y);

    // Convective
    drawArrow(W / 2 + 75, y, Math.PI * 0.3, 8, '#FF6E40', 0.85);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
    ctx.fillText('Convective transport (fluid motion)', W / 2 + 90, y);
}

// ── Animation loop ───────────────────────────────────────────────
let playing = true;

function frame() {
    // Background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Starfield
    for (const s of bgStars) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180,200,240,${s.a})`;
        ctx.fill();
    }

    // Draw star bodies
    for (const star of stars) drawStarBody(star);

    // Update and draw particles
    if (playing) {
        for (const p of allParticles) p.update();
    }

    for (const p of allParticles) {
        const [x, y] = p.xy();
        const dx = x - p.s.cx, dy = y - p.s.cy;
        const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        const rIn  = p.z.rf[0] * p.s.R;
        const rOut = p.z.rf[1] * p.s.R;

        if (d >= rIn - 1 && d <= rOut + 1) {
            const col = p instanceof RadParticle ? '#FFD54F' : '#FF6E40';
            drawArrow(x, y, p.angle(), p.sz, col, p.alpha());
        }
    }

    // Labels on top
    for (const star of stars) drawLabels(star);

    drawLegend();

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

canvas.addEventListener('click', () => { playing = !playing; });

frame();
</script>
</body>
</html>

Conclusions

Using model sensitivity analysis and simulated inference, I show that inferring tidal Qs from individual binaries is an ill-posed problem and alternatively, population constraints from samples of EB spin-orbit ratios may provide better leverage for constraining tides(Birky et al. 2025, Birky et al. 2026)
Finally, I develop a novel, physically motivated Gaussian process kernel for inferring differential rotation, inclination, and starspot properties just from stellar lightcurves (Birky et al. in prep)
So what comes next?

Furthermore, EB population in Kepler and TESS show a significant population of subsynchronous binaries which cannot be explained by tides and may be due to differential rotation (Hobson-Ritz & Birky et al. 2025)

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Tidal Star</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body { background: #000; overflow: hidden; }
canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
"use strict";

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx    = canvas.getContext("2d");

let W, H, R, cx, cy;
const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

function resize() {
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    R = Math.min(W, H) * 0.38;
    cx = W / 2;
    cy = H / 2;
    canvas.width  = W * dpr;
    canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width  = W + "px";
    canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}
resize();
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

// ── Mouse tracking ────────────────────────────────────────────────
let mouseX = cx + R * 2, mouseY = cy;
let prevX  = mouseX, prevY = mouseY;

window.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
});

// ── Tidal state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
let tidalAngle = 0.0;
let epsilon    = 0.0;
let lastT      = null;

function animate(t) {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    if (lastT === null) { lastT = t; return; }
    const dt = Math.min((t - lastT) / 1000, 0.05);
    lastT = t;

    // Direction and distance from star center to mouse
    const dx     = mouseX - cx, dy = mouseY - cy;
    const d_px   = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const d_norm = Math.max(0.3, d_px / R);   // normalized to star radius
    const angle  = Math.atan2(dy, dx);

    // Mouse velocity
    const vel = Math.hypot(mouseX - prevX, mouseY - prevY) / dt;
    prevX = mouseX; prevY = mouseY;

    // Target epsilon: only perturb when cursor is outside the unperturbed radius
    const targetEps = d_px > R
        ? Math.min(0.12, 0.15 / (d_norm ** 3)) + Math.min(0.03, vel * 0.00002)
        : 0.0;

    // Exponential lag on direction and amplitude
    const dAngle = ((angle - tidalAngle + 3 * Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI)) - Math.PI;
    tidalAngle += dAngle * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / 0.15));
    epsilon    += (targetEps - epsilon) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt / 0.2));

    // ── Draw ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W * dpr, H * dpr);

    // Deformed star
    const N = 360;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
        const theta = (i / N) * 2 * Math.PI;
        const alpha = theta - tidalAngle;
        const cosA  = Math.cos(alpha);
        const P2    = (3 * cosA * cosA - 1) / 2;
        const r     = R * (1 + epsilon * P2);
        const x     = cx + r * Math.cos(theta);
        const y     = cy + r * Math.sin(theta);
        i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#BF4040";
    ctx.fill();

    // Unperturbed outline (dashed circle)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, R, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.setLineDash([R * 0.07, R * 0.05]);
    ctx.lineWidth   = 1.2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
}

requestAnimationFrame(animate);
</script>
